prevention_rule: Fix HealthCheckHandler.cs:201-258 (ProbeMailboxAsync) to probe \\\\.\\pipe\\kongor-native-client directly (1.3ms latency) instead of stalling 21.3s on legacy TaoClient file-mailbox/EvalLuaSync timeouts and falsely reporting status: degraded.

prevention_rule: Always dispatch K2 UIScript lobby commands (Team, RequestMatchStart, Ready) through UIManager.GetInterface('main'):UICmd(...) rather than calling them as global Lua functions.

title: KONGOR-ENGINE-STATE-DTO-ACTIVEMATCHID-UINT32-SENTINEL-OVERFLOW
prevention_rule: EngineStateDto numeric fields must match native snprintf widths: dllmain.cpp case 0x0005 emits activeMatchId with %u (4294967295 = no-match sentinel); deserialize as long/uint, never int. Verify with a golden captured 0x0005 payload test, not DTO mocks.

prevention_rule: Inspect FastMCP _wrapped_call_tool signature in src/tools/frida/mcp_server.py; use Everything MCP to locate frida venv python.exe for direct Frida attach until patched.

title: KONGOR-GAME-CLIENT-MANAGE-START-ACTION-SILENT-STATUS-FALLTHROUGH
prevention_rule: Use action 'launch' (or 'start', now aliased to 'launch' in GameClientManageHandler) to spawn hon_x64.exe, and verify status != 'error' before waiting on ipc_ready.

prevention_rule: Treat Testing.GetEntityStatus(entityIdx) as an integer status return (1=Active, 2=Corpse, 0=Invalid) and inspect Testing.GetEntityInfo(entityIdx) for structured fields rather than indexing Testing.GetEntityStatus as a Lua table.

title: KONGOR-CLIENT-EVAL-LUA-TESTING-SPAWNUNIT-INTERNAL-HERO-ENTITY-NAME
prevention_rule: Always pass canonical internal K2 hero entity names (e.g. Hero_Frosty instead of Hero_Glacius, Hero_Rocky instead of Hero_Pebbles) and call Testing.Precache(entityName) before Testing.SpawnUnit.

title: kongor_wait_for condition lua treats EvalLua ERROR string as truthy satisfied
prevention_rule: In WaitForHandler.cs condition 'lua', reject responses starting with '[ERROR]' or 'false'/'nil'/'0' instead of treating non-empty error strings as satisfied: true.

title: EvalLua percent-s format specifiers mangled and global GetGamePhase nil in EvalLuaSync
prevention_rule: Query gamePhase via kongor_game_client_manage action:status or Host.GetGamePhase() rather than global GetGamePhase(). Error payloads encode % as \\u0025 to prevent host Go runtime fmt.Errorf mangling.

prevention_rule: For COMPEL workers read games/hon server/userdata/Heroes of Newerth x64/KONGOR/configuration/logs/Slave-N_DATE.log (UTF-16LE) or GET /instances/PORT/logs with Bearer token; check workingDirectory field in the response.

prevention_rule: On COMPEL workers, managed pipe hon-server-PORT forwards to stdin which K2 -dedicated ignores; verify execution via Slave-N log or use native pipe hon-server-native-PORT (0x0003/0x0004 ACK). Do not trust ipcResponse OK alone.

title: CS0009 Kongor.Cli.dll PE image lacks managed metadata in shadow runtime
prevention_rule: Filter native apphost/bundle PE assemblies without managed metadata before adding MetadataReference in AppEvalHandler, and query Postgres directly via Npgsql/psql when kongor_app_eval fails with CS0009.

title: kongor_game_client_manage Launch Rewrites masterserver.newbs.io to 127.0.0.1:55555
prevention_rule: GameClientManageHandler.Launch.cs and GameLauncherService.NormalizeMasterServerAddress preserve bare 'masterserver.newbs.io' without rewriting to 127.0.0.1:55555 or appending legacy port :83 so Cloudflare Tunnel (:80/:443) connections succeed.

prevention_rule: Do not call kongor_scrimmage_launch on ports managed by a running COMPEL supervisor (11235-11260); either stop COMPEL first for raw scrimmage or host via COMPEL/Lobby_V2 after kongor_wait_for(engine_ready).

title: Reports overallStatus degraded solely when optional dotnet-monitor 52323 is offline
prevention_rule: Treat optional dotnet-monitor (127.0.0.1:52323) offline as informational rather than degrading overallStatus when Redis, Database, MasterServer, ChatServer, Web API, Web UI, and COMPEL are healthy.

title: Counts intentional 20 FPS unfocused background sleep as 50ms frame hitches

title: Reports client running true on hon_x64.exe -dedicated server workers
prevention_rule: Cross-check kongor_game_client_manage(status) rather than relying on kongor_health_check client.running when COMPEL hon_x64.exe -dedicated workers are active; filter out -dedicated command lines in HealthCheckHandler.

title: Status reports static WASAPI 64ch audio summary instead of active kongor_audio mode

prevention_rule: Read games/client/logs/kongor_audio.log and console.log for authoritative FMOD output driver, speaker mode (Stereo vs 7.1), and channel count rather than relying on kongor_game_client_manage status audio.api/channels.

title: kongor_game_client_manage Launch Echoes Unredacted login_password MD5 in Logs and JSON Responses
prevention_rule: Use ClientCredentialManager.RedactSingleText on diagnostic log lines and JSON response arguments in GameClientManageHandler.Launch.cs while keeping unredacted joinedArguments solely for ProcessStartInfo and InteractiveProcessLauncher.

prevention_rule: Read HoN_Options.maxPossibleScroll instead of calling GetMaxValue() on K2 scrollbar widgets; only GetValue() and SetMaxValue() are bound.

verified_by: CompelManageHandler now resolves CompelOptions.ControlPlaneAuthenticationToken as default bearer header when authToken is omitted, eliminating HTTP 401 on localhost queries. Verified via unit and contract tests in Kongor.Mcp.Tests.

title: Multi-slot launch (slot >= 1) omits KONGOR_NATIVE_PIPE isolation and command fallback hits Slot 0
prevention_rule: Until GameClientManageHandler sets per-slot KONGOR_NATIVE_PIPE, pass launch-time credentials/connectAddress to slot >= 1 instead of post-launch pid IPC commands.

title: SecretsConfigView stdout log lines precede JSON output causing false error despite exit 0
prevention_rule: Invoke kongor_ui_render_view sequentially and verify output_path file existence when errorMessage reports 'Renderer exited with code 0' on views whose ViewModels write diagnostic lines to Console.Out.

title: Lua standard dofile fails on K2 virtual paths in EvalLua
prevention_rule: Use dofile('override/ui/scripts/...') relative to games/client CWD or ReloadInterface('main') instead of dofile('/ui/...') which bypasses K2 VFS.

title: UITrigger:Trigger rejects Lua table argument in EvalLua
prevention_rule: Pass individual string arguments (e.g. t:Trigger('6', '3', 'true')) to K2 UITrigger:Trigger(...) rather than wrapping parameters in a Lua table.

title: launch binds svr_port from startup.cfg instead of port 11235 and rejects unarranged Connect
prevention_rule: Use kongor_compel_manage(action: 'start') to spawn arranged dedicated server workers registered with chat-server:11031 instead of raw kongor_game_server_manage(action: 'launch').

title: move_to emits 'Order move' rejected by CConsole::DoCommand

prevention_rule: Do not rely on kongor_game_action(action: 'move_to') over client console IPC because K2 CConsole::DoCommand rejects 'Order'; drive bot/unit movement via CBotBrain Lua or server scripts.

title: click_widget marks StartGame buttons status:fail on stock world-load CFileManager logs
prevention_rule: When clicking a widget that triggers synchronous StartGame world loading (e.g. botmatch_btn_start), verify gamePhase == 3 and map load in console.log rather than treating stock S2 CFileManager::GetFile .clip warnings as UI script errors.

title: kongor stdio MCP 3m0s timeout when mcp_config points to VSTest testhost.exe or stale temp shadow binary
prevention_rule: Configure mcpServers.kongor in mcp_config.json to launch python -u src/tools/tao_mcp.py with PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 and DOTNET_ROOT; never register ephemeral %TEMP%/kongor_mcp_runtime/pid_* shadow paths or testhost.exe.

title: browser_run_code_unsafe lacks global fetch and requires null arg before waitForFunction options
prevention_rule: In playwright browser_run_code_unsafe, use page.request.post(url, { data: buffer }) instead of global fetch(), and pass null as the 2nd argument to page.waitForFunction(fn, null, { timeout }) so options are not treated as pageFunction arg.

title: page.screenshot times out waiting on infinite CSS animations or Google Fonts
prevention_rule: Pass animations: 'disabled' (and timeout: 10000) to page.screenshot({ fullPage: false, animations: 'disabled' }) on pages with continuous CSS animations or blocked external font requests.

title: playwright MCP fails with exit status 125 when Docker Desktop daemon is restarting or stopped
prevention_rule: Verify Docker Desktop daemon health before invoking Docker-backed playwright MCP; if Docker daemon is restarting or unavailable, wait for com.docker.backend readiness or run local host Playwright.

title: status returns 0 workers when COMPEL /api/servers serializes running instead of isRunning or runs on :11484
prevention_rule: Parse both 'running' and 'isRunning' (and 'tickrateHz'/'currentTickrateHz') in GameServerManageHandler.DiscoverCompelManagedServers, include port 11484 alongside 11234/11334/11434, and exclude games/client hon_x64.exe (willowmaker-ipc) from IsDedicatedServerProcess.

title: mcp-server-docker stale named pipe handle after Docker Desktop engine restart
prevention_rule: After restarting Docker Desktop or WSL2 on Windows, mcp-server-docker.exe caches a closed //./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine handle; fall back to docker CLI or restart mcp-server-docker before calling docker MCP tools.

title: kongor_capture_window inbound JSON-RPC frame exceeded maximum line length on high-entropy 1080p PNG
prevention_rule: Use scripts/capture_verified_window.ps1 -OutputPath <path> when capturing high-entropy 1080p/1440p terrain scenes whose inline PNG Base64 response exceeds stdio JSON-RPC line limits.

title: kongor_k2_ui_inspect static/auto mode and kongor_client_navigate autoBoot blocked by offline client preflight
prevention_rule: Only enforce hon_x64.exe online preflight on kongor_k2_ui_inspect when mode=='live', and on kongor_client_navigate when autoBoot==false.

title: kongor_reload_and_verify fails capabilities_staleness_check when skipBuildSync=true after Lua edits
prevention_rule: Leave skipBuildSync=false (the default) on kongor_reload_and_verify so update_tao_build.ps1 refreshes the tao.lua build hash before ReloadInterfaces.

title: kongor_client_practice warm reuse invalidated by GetGamePhase()==3 and SpawnHero no-op on already-spawned player
prevention_rule: Probe K2 UI Lua via UIGamePhase() (>=5), Testing.GetMountedWorld()/GetMap(), ViewingReplay()/ViewingStreaming(), and Testing.PlayerHasValidHero(); swap heroes in-place via Testing.Delete + Testing.Precache + Testing.SpawnUnit + Testing.SetPlayerHero + Testing.LevelUp.

title: Offline catalog discovery incorrectly reports LiveVerified fidelity
prevention_rule: Use StaticOfflineAnalysis for offline catalog list, search and describe; reserve LiveVerified for verified in-engine execution.

title: Describe emits failing VFS resolve example without virtualPath
prevention_rule: Generate action-aware example arguments and test examples against the target handler; resolve requires a virtualPath.

title: Offline VFS locate inherits LiveVerified default
prevention_rule: Offline handlers must specify StaticOfflineAnalysis; avoid defaulting execution fidelity to LiveVerified.

title: Rider apply_patch discovery and quoted hunk context failed
prevention_rule: Supply a nonempty input patch and avoid unescaped quotes in command-line patch contexts; verify edits through the IDE.

title: K2 linter treats legacy event scripts as Lua
verified_by: f3c7add47 + McpToolContractTests.Tranche2 + live NetGuard stdio audit (main.interface 0 errors)
prevention_rule: Distinguish legacy K2 event attributes from onloadlua and other Lua callbacks before applying Lua syntax rules.

title: Concurrent TAO startup collides on mailbox cleanup
verified_by: b5f8259 + McpToolContractTests.Tranche1B + live NetGuard stdio audit
prevention_rule: Serialize mailbox initialization across server processes or handle sharing violations without resetting an active mailbox.

title: Static or canned payloads returned as live success
prevention_rule: A handler may only return data it read during the call; canned or fallback values must fail or be labelled SimulatedTestDouble.

title: assert_visual passes unrelated images and visual_diff uses synthetic inputs
verified_by: f3c7add47 + McpToolContractTests.Tranche2 + live NetGuard stdio audit
prevention_rule: Visual assertions must fail when diff percentage exceeds the threshold and must never substitute synthetic baselines or candidates.

title: Native bridge rejects rpc request type used by fixture and match tools
verified_by: b5f8259 + McpToolContractTests.Tranche1B + live NetGuard stdio audit
prevention_rule: Every request type a handler sends must be listed by kongor_tao_capabilities; check capability before dispatch and fail fast with the missing capability name.

title: Default discovery misses replays, parquet files, dumps and archived models
verified_by: 3379aa36e + McpToolContractTests.Tranche3 + live NetGuard stdio audit (Hero_Pyromancer, Hero_Fayde, Hero_Accursed)
prevention_rule: Discovery defaults must search the same locations the engine and sibling tools use, and report the directories searched when nothing is found.

title: Database tools target a remote database while documented as local
verified_by: b5f8259 + McpToolContractTests.Tranche1B + live NetGuard stdio audit
prevention_rule: Database tools must print the resolved endpoint, refuse mutating actions on non-loopback hosts without explicit confirmation, and describe the real default.

title: Launch default follows launcher settings public master server not documented loopback
prevention_rule: Launch defaults must match the advertised schema default (loopback); a non-loopback master server or saved-credential auto-login requires an explicit argument.

title: ui_control invoke sends real mouse input for offscreen client
prevention_rule: Never synthesize OS-level mouse or keyboard input for an offscreen or headless target; route to in-engine widget dispatch or fail with an actionable error.

title: Action tools report success without verifying engine effect
verified_by: f3c7add47 + McpToolContractTests.Tranche2 + live NetGuard stdio audit
prevention_rule: A mutating tool reports success only after reading back the changed engine state; a console ACK alone is status dispatched_unverified.

title: Visual proof shows previous screen while verified is true
verified_by: f3c7add47 + ClientNavigateHandler swapchain settle barrier + live NetGuard stdio audit
prevention_rule: Capture proof only after the target widget is visible and a new frame has been published; reject frames older than the dispatch time.

title: Simulation rate limit blocks read-only status and dry-run calls
prevention_rule: Rate-limit by action cost: status, list, errors and dryRun actions are billed to ReadOnly, never to the Simulation budget.

title: Advertised schemas and handler behaviour disagree across tools
prevention_rule: Generate the input schema and the handler dispatch table from one source and test every advertised enum value and parameter name in CI.

title: Inconsistent result envelope and misattributed remediation hints
prevention_rule: Every tool returns one envelope (status, isError, errorCode, message, remediation) and attaches an MCP issue only when the error signature matches it.

title: Inspect and reload responses exceed 25 KB by default
prevention_rule: Default responses stay under 8 KB; honour depth, filter and limit parameters and return large payloads as an artifact path.

title: Performance and log metrics are miscomputed or contradictory
verified_by: 1ebe5f40d + f3c7add47 + Step 0 dual-ring live probe + PerfWindowHandler FastBus priority & lossless drain + PerfWindowTests
prevention_rule: Each metric has one source of truth; derive High-Hz FPS and frame pacing from vid_vulkan Local\\KongorTelemetryBuffer QPC deltas with lossless draining and never read version.dll's 20 Hz Local\\KongorClientTelemetry_<pid> guard ring as render frames.

title: Lifecycle state is per-session and stop results are inaccurate
prevention_rule: Persist managed process and rule registries outside the MCP process and confirm every stop by re-probing the target before reporting success.

title: Requested capture method silently falls back to window capture
prevention_rule: An explicitly requested capture method either succeeds or fails; fallbacks happen only for auto and are reported with the reason.
